marta (BillingOps): Heads up — noticed ~120 invoices synced to NetSuite where amount fields are USD but NetSuite "currency" ended up set to EUR, so the system applied exchange adjustments. First appeared around 03:12 UTC this morning after last night's webhook mapper deploy.

emma (Finance): ugh. that will mess up cash / bank recon. do we know scope?

marta (BillingOps): ~120 invoices across 30 customers, all created after 2024-03-28T23:50 UTC. Looks correlated with the mapper change that touched Stripe invoice metadata parsing.

raj (Eng): I'm on it. quick summary: a recent deploy renamed the metadata key we read from Stripe from `currency_code` -> `currency`. The mapper code that builds the NetSuite invoice still checks only `currency_code`, so when absent it fell back to account default (EUR).

lewis (Support): flagging as P1 to affected customers. Please do NOT create manual journal entries yet — they'll be overwritten if we replay.

marta (BillingOps): Can we make mapper accept both keys as a fast mitigation?

raj (Eng): yes. I'll patch mapper to prefer `currency` then `currency_code`. Pushing a hotfix to staging now, will promote to prod after smoke. ETA ~15m.

netsuite-bot: [ALERT] 114 GL mapping failures detected for subsidiary EUR_Main for invoices posted since 2024-03-29T03:12Z. See /alerts/114.

raj (Eng): Hotfix deployed to prod. Next: we need to backfill the affected invoices. Plan: run the idempotent backfill that re-sends the Stripe invoice payloads to NetSuite with corrected currency mapping. Running dry-run first.

marta (BillingOps): Important: ensure backfill is create-or-update (idempotent) and doesn't double-post payments.

raj (Eng): Backfill uses external_id to upsert. I will run dry-run: `python tools/ns_backfill.py --source stripe --ids /tmp/affected_ids.txt --dry-run --check-idempotency`

marta (BillingOps): share sample transformed payload from dry-run so finance can sanity-check GL and exchange behavior.

raj (Eng): Sample transformed payload (dry-run) below:

```
{
  "external_id": "stripe_inv_1J2a3b",
  "customer_external_id": "cus_7XyZ",
  "amount": 12345,
  "currency": "USD",
  "line_items": [ { "desc": "api calls", "amount": 12345, "tax_code": "SAAS" } ],
  "metadata": { "currency": "USD", "currency_code": "USD", "experiment": "pricing-v2" }
}
```

raj (Eng): Dry-run shows NetSuite mapping will set currency=USD now and post without exchange conversion. No duplicate invoices created in dry-run.

emma (Finance): good. once you run full backfill, finance will check bank/GL and we may need one small adjusting journal for the weekend window. keep me posted.

lewis (Support): I'll draft a customer-facing note for the impacted accounts and freeze any manual reconciliation edits until confirmation from finance.

marta (BillingOps): Action items: (1) raj run full backfill after 30m monitoring window, (2) lewis prepare customer comms, (3) emma review post-backfill GLs. I'll compile list of affected invoice ids and owners.

raj (Eng): Running full backfill now (2024-03-29T04:26Z). Command: `python tools/ns_backfill.py --source stripe --ids /tmp/affected_ids.txt --fix-currency` — will report when complete.

marta (BillingOps): thanks — will standby to validate.

emma (Finance): thx team.
